statement: The FOMC raises the target range for the federal funds rate at its scheduled 2026-09-16 decision. Reference: 3.50 to 3.75 percent in effect on the packet date.
resolution: The FOMC statement dated 2026-09-16 on federalreserve.gov announces a target range whose upper bound exceeds 3.75 percent. Reference: 3.50 to 3.75 percent on 2026-09-10.
failure_condition: The 2026-09-16 FOMC statement leaves the target range upper bound at or below 3.75 percent.

control_basis.rule: climatological — same probability for every row drawn from the same reference class
control_basis.note: pre-registered before the outcome existed. This is the floor the forecaster arm must clear; it is not an attempt to be right.
